pages.title: Minkowski Lattice
pages.text: Space and time woven into a single four-dimensional geometry, with a light cone at every point separating the reachable future from the forbidden elsewhere. The lattice is flat but strange: distances can be zero between distinct events, and time behaves like an imaginary direction.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Minkowski realised Lorentz transformations were just rotations in a four-dimensional spacetime. I combined Lorentz crystals with a differential manifold and quaternions in the Tensor Calculus Engine, and the light cones appeared.
